rules: close if a supported carrier response graph fits a certified triangle or star
delete a guard-forced outside block when its complete switched partner pattern is absent
close cap67 by hyperplane avoidance when its response map has nonzero kernel and every activity functional restricts nontrivially to that kernel
inherit a sealed lower-support certificate after an exact guard deletion

decreasing_measure.guard_step: mu strictly decreases by at least one
decreasing_measure.termination: every sequence of guard deletions terminates
decreasing_measure.stable_condition: a nonzero outside pair A_r6,A_r7 can remain only with both switched partners A17,A26

minimal_obstruction.why_hyperplane_rule_stops: the K4 support certificate does not establish a nonzero kernel for L_C; rank(L_C)<=8 and nontriviality of all four activity restrictions remain unproved
minimal_obstruction.minimality_basis: the sealed zero-through-six theorem closes every smaller added support

first_missing_lemma.name: complete-switched-rectangle K4 response-minor lemma
first_missing_lemma.statement: On each of the six full-family seven-block representatives (and its guard-symmetry mate), the exact source/residual/guard equations either force one nominally nonzero block to zero, or yield a supported carrier C for which rank(L_C)<=8 and each of K00,K11,K22,<K,A_C> is nonzero as a functional on ker(L_C).
first_missing_lemma.why_sufficient: over Q a finite union of four proper hyperplanes cannot cover the nonzero response kernel, so one K is simultaneously clean and active; the forced-zero alternative descends to the sealed at-most-six theorem
first_missing_lemma.why_not_already_proved: support alone permits the K4 response graph and therefore does not imply the required response-minor or activity-row conditions
first_missing_lemma.required_new_input: coefficient-level response-minor/guard equation analysis on the six exact symmetry representatives, or a new structural identity implying the stated dichotomy
